title: Critical PwnEscape Linux Kernel Vulnerability Lets Guest VMs Read Host Memory
summary: A newly disclosed critical flaw in the Linux kernel allows code inside a virtual machine to read memory on the host computer it runs on. A researcher demonstrated the leak against Vercel's live cloud sandboxes, and Vercel confirmed it.
